revisions.reason: 2026-11-24 handleWheel zero vertical delta only: return before keyboard/process ownership restoration when deltaY === 0, including negative zero and horizontal-only DOM events. These events no longer publish DirectInput state or enter USER callbacks. DOM cancellation remains in the unchanged browser producer. Nonzero routing, synchronous send_message, exception paths, retained references, timers, continuations and invocation lifetime are unchanged. Prepared independent oracle reproduced 138 original failures and 494 passing assertions across 29 rows with the actual applied one-line candidate; complete memory and owner guards included. No invocation ownership assertion; broader ownership remains pending.
